This plan costs 312: 232 driving minutes plus 80 in deferral penalties. Belkot school is not an evacuation point, so the three shopkeepers there are carried out to Benighat shelter.

- **Roads:** The usable roads are Myagang–Dupcheshwar, Benighat–Dupcheshwar, Benighat–Jwalamukhi, Kalika–Likhu, Jwalamukhi–Likhu, Dupcheshwar–Belkot, Kakani–Galchhi, Tadi–Galchhi, Dupcheshwar–Galchhi, Benighat–Belkot, Jwalamukhi–Belkot and Tarkeshwar–Belkot.
- **Car1, first trip (28 min):** It picks up the three shopkeepers at Belkot and the injured farmer at Tarkeshwar, then returns to Benighat.
- **Car1, Myagang trips (38 min each):** The first trip carries the three children and one adult. The second carries the remaining three adults. Each trip costs less than deferring those people.
- **Car2, first trip (38 min):** It collects the bus driver at Likhu and the three elderly people at Jwalamukhi, then drives to Benighat.
- **Car2, Kakani trip (90 min):** It picks up the two elderly people and one adult at Kakani. On the way back it takes the elderly widow at Galchhi, which fills the car.
- **Deferred (80):** The young woman at Jwalamukhi (20), one adult at Kakani (20) and two adults at Tadi (40). Rescuing each of these costs at least as much as the penalty.
